issue_title: prepare_agent_suggestion residual honesty: align with #309 identity model + #308 App prep status
problem_statement:
prepare_agent_suggestion residual honesty: align with #309 identity model + #308 App prep status

Part of #26 (post-rescope residual). Does **not** close the parent (L-013).

## Context

After #12/#18 closed and children #308 (update-bot registration package) + #309 (identity reconciliation) shipped, `prepare_agent_suggestion` still emits residual lines that read as if #18 is open and as if "per-agent identity under one license" is the model. That is **docs≠reality** for continuous agents (Hermes/OpenClaw) reading the tool surface.

## Scope (fleet mcpcore: `apps/mcp/lib/**` only; app only if tool description strings need a one-line align)

- `apps/mcp/lib/prepare-agent-suggestion.ts` residual + notice strings
- Matching unit sensors in `apps/mcp/lib/prepare-agent-suggestion.test.ts` (UNIT-26-2-*)
- Optional: contract comment maps that still say "deferred #18 residual"

**Out of scope (other lane or later child):**

- `apps/mcp/content/docs/**` residual wording (external-autonomous-agents, agent-facing-layer) — fleet mcpcore must not edit content; note for docs/marketing lane
- GitHub App code, webhooks, secrets, registration
- Roles/entitlement implementation (design is #309; build is a later child)
- Chat merge/approve tools

## Sprint contract

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| Residual no longer cites open **#18 residual** as the App tracker | Strings name Mark-gated App registration; #308 package shipped, registration still pending |
| Residual no longer claims **per-agent identity under one license** | States person-licensed + agent-as-delegate (`driver` label); site roles not built yet (#309) |
| UNIT-26-2 residual sensors pass on the new wording | `prepare-agent-suggestion.test.ts` updated; gate green |
| No secrets, no App code, no entitlements schema, no package.json | Diff limited to lib residual honesty + tests |
| Parent #26 stays OPEN | PR body: `Related to #26` + `Closes #<this>`; no `Closes #26` |

## Tier

A (honesty strings + unit sensors on existing tool).

## Dependencies

None — pure string/sensor realignment against closed #308/#309.
